name: rosetta-temperature-conversion
code:
use IO.Std.write_line

show(kelvin: double) is
    write_line("K {kelvin,8:F2}")
    write_line("C {kelvin - 273.15,8:F2}")
    write_line("F {kelvin * 1.8 - 459.67,8:F2}")
    write_line("R {kelvin * 1.8,8:F2}")
si

show(21.0)
